newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NFI fund picks privatisation advisers.
newsitem.headline: Polish NFI fund picks privatisation advisers.

text.p: National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 8 in Poland's mass privatisation programme picked privatisation advisers and plans to enter the Warsaw bourse at the start of 1997, it said in a statement on Wednesday.

NFI No. 8 picked Polish consulting firm Access Limited, Bank Handlowy's Centrum Operacji Kapitalowych and British investment bank NM Rothschild & Sons Limited to advise in the fund's planned flotation.
"The management of the fund is interested in placing it on the bourse as quickly as possible," the statement said, adding that it hoped entry could be as early as in January 1997.
The NFI programme groups more than 500 firms undergoing privatisation into 15 funds.
